test_title: PYST 33: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 19 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: If the selling price of a bed is 2-times of initial, then the profit is 7-times of initial. Find the initial profit percentage (in %)
solution:
**Given:**

S.P.(new) = 2 × S.P.(initial)

Profit(new) = 7 × Profit(initial)

**Formula used:**

Profit = S.P. - C.P.

Profit% = (Profit / C.P.) × 100

**Calculation:**

Let initial C.P. = y, initial profit = ×

S.P.(initial) = y + ×

S.P.(new) = 2(y + ×)

Profit(new) = 2(y + ×) - y = y + 2×

Given: y + 2× = 7×

⇒ y = 5×

Initial Profit% = (× / 5×) × 100

⇒ 20%

**∴ Initial profit percentage = 20%**
